description: This file contains functions for collecting and reporting process-related information on Windows, including process ancestry, debugger presence, and memory usage, used for tracing purposes in a Git-related project.

methods.name: find_pid
methods.description: Finds process data for a given PID in a snapshot and updates PROCESSENTRY32.

methods.name: get_processes
methods.description: Builds a JSON array of parent processes by walking the PPID chain.

methods.name: get_ancestry
methods.description: Collects and outputs the process ancestry as JSON.

methods.name: get_is_being_debugged
methods.description: Checks if a debugger is attached to the current process.

methods.name: get_peak_memory_info
methods.description: Reports peak memory usage of the current process.

methods.name: trace2_collect_process_info
methods.description: Main entry point to collect process info based on reason (startup or exit).
